bait_content.title: Cache Sync Required (snapd)
bait_content.body: Updates for core22, snap-store and gtk-common-themes are downloaded. Running applications are using outdated confinement profiles. To prevent policy mismatches and I/O stalls, save your work and apply the refresh to restart affected services.
